checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R6 is under-rated as SUGGESTION ('optional polish' in the Verdict) although it is a contradiction between the change and a stable MUST: openspec/specs/grid-view/spec.md:588 'Accessible meeting state' says 'The Tab order MUST be: «Поделиться встречей», «Сбросить выбор встречи», then for each row its span button and its hour strip, then the meeting handles «Начало встречи», «Конец встречи»', while the delta's ADDED 'Move handle is a slider' (specs/grid-view/spec.md:509) adds «Сдвиг встречи» as one more Tab stop after the end handle and does not modify that requirement. This is the same class as R3 (rated WARNING): after archive the stable spec disagrees with the change. R6 should be WARNING and blocking, the Consistency section should list it as a second contradiction (Summary 'Contradictions' 2), and the Verdict's blocking list should include it.
